title: fix(spec,plugin-sharing,scripts): retire the organization-less text step 7 left behind; check-tenant-chokepoint accepts where(tenant, 'is not', null)
body:
Fixes #24902

Clause-②: no (description and help text, plus a CI gate's rule: no response, status, outcome, boot verdict or export moves)
Metadata-protocol: none (a schema description and a field's help text; nothing a metadata author writes changes)

## What changed

**1. Text that contradicted behaviour after 18.x step 7**
- `packages/spec/src/api/events.zod.ts`: the `DataEvent.organizationId` TSDoc and `.describe()`. They said every event on a `single` deployment carries no organization because "nothing stamps the column". Under ADR-0131 D9, every tenant row on a single-organization deployment is stamped with the Default Organization the engine derives (`resolveSystemInsertOrganization`, `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`), so its events carry it. The text now matches `content/docs/protocol/objectql/schema.mdx`. Absence is described as two cases: a row of an object outside the wall, and every row of a composition that registers no organization object. The schema itself is unchanged. `content/docs/references/api/events.mdx` was regenerated (`check:generated --fix`, then a re-check: 14/14 up to date).
- `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/objects/sys-sharing-rule.object.ts`: the Organization help said "null = global". It now reads "The organization this rule belongs to.", which follows this object's admin-facing rule (no tables, columns or ADRs in a `description`). A code comment above it points to the typed `deploymentWide` projection (`sharing-rule-service.ts`). The `en` bundle was regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`. The zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES values are hand-written and were updated to match, because merge mode keeps translated values and they would otherwise still say "null = global".
- The three "stays NULL on single-tenant" comments in #25128 (C1) are not in these files, so they stay with #25128.

**2. The gate nit:** `scripts/check-tenant-chokepoint.mjs`
- The header says `IS NOT NULL` is never refused. The rule refused every three-argument `where(tenant, …, null)`, including `where(tenant, 'is not', null)`. Knex compiles that call to `IS NOT NULL`: `knex/lib/query/querybuilder.js:456-457`, operator lower-cased and trimmed.
- The rule now exempts exactly a literal `'is not'` operator, matched the way Knex matches it. An operator the gate cannot read is still refused. The header names all three `IS NOT NULL` spellings.
- Self-test: there is one new silent case (`'is not'` and `' IS NOT '`) and one new refused case (a non-literal operator). The `D8 null-arm rule` battery floor goes from 22 to 24.
- Reverse check: I replaced the new condition with `true`, and the self-test went red (exit 1) on the new silent case. The file was restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, and `git diff HEAD` was empty afterwards.

**3. The dormant paths: both are KEPT, with reasons. Neither is retired.**

`organizationOutOfWriteReach` (`packages/services/service-storage/src/metadata-store.ts:800`) is **alive**:
- Callers: `storage-routes.ts:780`, inside `requireStartingOrganization`. Three upload doors use it: the presigned commit door, chunked completion, and the progress door when its expiry stamp is due. It is the guard behind the `409` an uploader gets after switching organization. It has a door-level pin in `error-envelope.conformance.test.ts:226-245` (the commit door after an organization switch) and unit pins in `metadata-store.test.ts:368-405`. Probe: `vitest run src/error-envelope.conformance.test.ts src/metadata-store.test.ts -t 'switching active organization|organizationOutOfWriteReach'` gives 2 files, 7 passed. service-storage is not in this diff, so CI does not run it.
- Only its organization-less-row branch (`metadata-store.ts:809`) was written against the retired NULL arm. That branch can still run. The v18 boot guard is composed by `os serve` alone (`packages/runtime/src/organization-ownership-boot-guard.ts`, "Where it runs"). An embedding host that does not compose it can boot a database that has not been through the ceremony and still holds a v17 organization-less `sys_file` / `sys_upload_session` row.
- So nothing is removed. One finding is left for the seat (see Acceptance notes).

The `sys_record_share` backfill apply pass (`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/backfill-sys-record-share-organizations.ts`) is **dead in every shipped build, but has a published reach**:
- No production caller. The only callers are tests: `backfill-sys-record-share-organizations.test.ts` and `record-share-organization-stamp.test.ts:315`.
- It does not ship: the tsup entry is `src/index.ts` alone, `files` is `dist`, and the index does not export it.
- Probe (a throwaway vitest that was not committed): on a `sys_record_share` table created by the 18.x driver with no relax, storing an organization-less grant is refused (`NOT NULL`). `planSysRecordShareOrganizationBackfill` answers `{scanned: 0, planned: 0}`, and the apply pass writes 0. The existing real-driver pin can only build its legacy rows because it first relaxes the column (`record-share-organization-stamp.test.ts:180`).
- **External reach, so it is kept:** the published 17.3 release notes (`content/docs/releases/v17/17-3.mdx:44-48, 284-289`) tell operators to run `planSysRecordShareOrganizationBackfill` / `runSysRecordShareOrganizationBackfill(engine, { dryRun: false })`. The CLI ceremony inventory cites the file as its derivation (`packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-inventory.ts:538`). Retiring it also moves two ledgers outside this claim's file surface: `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json:3670` and the tenant-audit census counts. Per the dispatch, this is the seat's call.

## Acceptance notes
- **For the seat, the open question:** the organization-less branch of `organizationOutOfWriteReach` answers "in reach". Since D8, the driver's scoped write cannot reach such a row, so on a host without the boot guard the door writes, misses, and answers the `500` outage text. Option A: keep it as it is; that state only exists on a database that has not been through the ceremony. Option B: make the door refuse such a row with its own answer. That needs a new refusal text, and it touches `storage-routes.ts`, which is outside this claim. I recommend A, and noting it for #24897's ADR text.
- **For the seat, the open question:** retire the `sys_record_share` backfill or keep it. Option A: keep it until the 17.x upgrade window is formally closed. Option B: retire the module, its two tests and the two ledger rows now, and add an erratum PR for the 17.3 notes. I recommend A.
- The claim names `packages/platform-objects/src/**/sys-sharing-rule.object.ts`. The file is actually at `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/objects/`. I edited it there.
- The storage-routes comment (`storage-routes.ts:761`) "a row stamped with no organization stays in reach" has the same staleness as the branch above. It is outside the file surface, so I left it.

## Verification
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 706 files, 21465 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing test`: 53 files, 1200 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-tenant-chokepoint.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, 12 refused and 7 silent. The scan itself exits 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 130 commands. 130 commands on head `02067f8c`, each exit code captured before any pipe: 127 exit 0 on the first pass. Three exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, nothing measured). `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed a pinned commit the shallow clone lacked; after fetching it, exit 0. `spec check:skill-examples` needed `client-react` built; after building it, exit 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs ten packages this diff does not touch (studio, client-react, connector-slack and others) built, so it is **NOT MEASURED locally** and declared to CI. `--ran` reconciliation: 130 derived, 130 run, 0 unrun.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch origin/claude/issue-24902-tenant-text-dormant-paths`: NOT governed, 95 changed lines.
- Size **S**. Not a governed surface, so it lands through the ordinary queue.
